notes.title: Under Maintenance Live Stream!
notes.content:
One of the writers and creators of [i]Under Maintenance[/i] - Tsukasa Yuki - will be streaming the game and answering any questions she's able to. The Stream will be available through Steam and Twitch and starting at 11:00 AM CDT, Wednesday, August 9th! 

For Steam's Stream: https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198251168838

For Twitch, check out: https://www.twitch.tv/tsubasanoyuki

Not in CDT time? No worries! Here's a handy time-zone converter: https://dateful.com/time-zone-converter
